title: Tsunami question
content: So I am in my early mid 40’s and my entire life I have had the exact same dream of a tsunami coming towards me. I am on the 3-4 story of a building I would guess and the room’s wall facing the tsunami is all glass. I have never been in this room or this place in this lifetime. I have always been looking for it. The tsunami is like the one in Deep Impact regarding the height. The dream is the same min or so of this tsunami coming at me. Like a horrid loop. The beach goers outfits remind me of the bathing suits of the early 1900’s but the world is to modern to be happening back then. Now I have experience a few other dreams that the world felt the same as the tsunami. I have a few other reoccurring dreams of the same places with same feeling. There is a locker room that seems to go on forever and about every 200’ or so there is little hallway of lockers that leads to a weird indoor hot springs type area. Now this forever locker room is spotless clean. I figured I would add after hearing about the bathrooms. There is another place that is like a trailer park in the swamps and it is night with hardly any light. And I am trying to get away which leads to a weird underground area with pipes that you have to walk on or will fall to an abyss. While in this world when I try to say anything or even scream I cant. My voice is gone and I am having to fight myself to try and control the body which usually leads to me being frozen. So I try to just watch most of the time to figure out what is going on. Does these places in my dreams sound like Mall World?
